scope: Stateful recommendation pagination and exclusion regression
conversation_sequence: Recommend a generic snack category and capture the first visible IDs
Ask for another item and verify the first page IDs are excluded
Ask again after exhaustion and verify no product is repeated
Switch to drinks and verify the previous category exclusion set is cleared
Start a fresh snack request and verify the original first page can be shown again
limitations: The route-level regression stubs the catalog lookup and uses generated generic fixture products.
The full retail-tools suite exercises real deterministic catalog filtering and pagination, but no live database, Groq provider, browser, or current store inventory was tested.
The checks verify state handoff and duplicate exclusion, not semantic relevance or human-rated recommendation quality.
branch_policy: Continued on the existing branch; no branch or worktree was created.
